import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter for significant features (p < 0.05, |t| > 2)
    sig_idx = [i for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids) 
               if abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:,i][feats.y==1], feats.x[:,i][feats.y==0])[0]) > 2]
    
    if not sig_idx:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Cluster correlated features (|r| >= 0.6)
    corr_pairs = [(i,j) for i in sig_idx for j in sig_idx if i<j 
                  if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:,i], feats.x[:,j])[0,1]) >= 0.6]
    
    if not corr_pairs:
        # No strong correlations, pick top features by t-statistic
        t_stats = [stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:,i][feats.y==1], feats.x[:,i][feats.y==0])[0] 
                   for i in sig_idx]
        top_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in sorted(sig_idx, key=lambda i: abs(t_stats[i]), reverse=True)]
        return Design(
            drivers=(top_features[0],) if top_features else (),
            columns=top_features[:10],
            products=(),
            loadings={top_features[0]: 1.0} if top_features else {}
        )
    
    # Form clusters using hierarchical clustering
    all_features = list(set([f for pair in corr_pairs for f in pair]))
    if len(all_features) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Build similarity matrix from correlations
    n = len(all_features)
    sim_matrix = np.zeros((n, n))
    for i, j in corr_pairs:
        try:
            idx_i = all_features.index(i)
            idx_j = all_features.index(j)
            sim_matrix[idx_i, idx_j] = sim_matrix[idx_j, idx_i] = abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:,i], feats.x[:,j])[0,1])
        except ValueError:
            continue
    
    # Cluster features based on similarity
    clustering = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=1, linkage='average')
    try:
        cluster_labels = clustering.fit_predict(1 - sim_matrix)  # Convert to distance
    except:
        # Fallback to single cluster
        cluster_labels = np.zeros(n)
    
    # Get the main cluster
    main_cluster = [all_features[i] for i in range(n) if cluster_labels[i] == 0]
    
    if not main_cluster:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute weighted score from cluster members
    weights = np.array([abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:,feats.column(fid)][feats.y==1], 
                                          feats.x[:,feats.column(fid)][feats.y==0])[0]) 
                       for fid in main_cluster])
    weights = weights / np.sum(weights) if np.sum(weights) > 0 else np.ones(len(weights)) / len(weights)
    
    loadings = dict(zip(main_cluster, weights))
    
    # Select top drivers by effect size
    drivers = tuple(sorted(main_cluster, key=lambda fid: abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[:,feats.column(fid)][feats.y==1], 
                                                                           feats.x[:,feats.column(fid)][feats.y==0])[0]), 
                          reverse=True)[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # Include interaction terms between top features
    products = tuple([(a,b) for i, a in enumerate(drivers) for b in drivers[i+1:] 
                      if abs(np.corrcoef(feats.x[:,feats.column(a)], feats.x[:,feats.column(b)])[0,1]) >= 0.6])
    
    return Design(
        drivers=drivers,
        columns=main_cluster,
        products=products,
        loadings=loadings
    )
